 NFL News Roundup Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 9 games: Rams WR Puka Nacua to undergo testing on knee injury 
 Published: Updated: Loading... Around the NFL Staff NFL.com Share Facebook Share Twitter Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 9 Sunday: 
 Arizona Cardinals defensive lineman Roy Lopez (toe) was ruled out of Sunday's loss to Seattle.
 Chicago Bears  defensive back Tyrique Stevenson (hand) did not return to Sunday's win against the Buccaneers. Wide receiver Luther Burden III suffered a concussion late in Sunday's loss. 
 Dallas Cowboys  safety P.J. Locke suffered a concussion in Sunday's win over the Colts, head coach Brian Schottenheimer said . Tight end Jake Ferguson will undergo tests on his knee on Monday, per Schottenheimer.
 Denver Broncos  wide receiver Jaylen Waddle and cornerback Riley Moss were ruled out after suffering concussions in the first half of Sunday's win over Carolina.
 Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs (hand) suffered a fractured finger in the first quarter of Sunday's win over New England, head coach Matt LaFleur said. Jacobs did not return to the game, but LaFleur told reporters the team is hoping to find a way for him to play through the broken finger in the future. Linebacker  Ty'Ron Hopper (chest) was ruled out.
 Indianapolis Colts linebacker Jaylon Carlies (neck) and offensive tackle Jalen Travis (knee) were ruled out of Sunday's loss to Dallas.
 Kansas City Chiefs  quarterback Patrick Mahomes suffered an elbow sprain in Sunday's win over the Jets but an MRI did not reveal a major injury, per NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport, who added Mahomes' elbow will be monitored over the next few days for pain and swelling. Mahomes was able to re-enter the game following the injury, which took place in the second quarter. Wide receiver Xavier Worthy (hamstring) was ruled out. Offensive tackle  Jaylon Moore (ankle) did not return.
 Las Vegas Raiders  guard Trey Zuhn III (concussion) was ruled out of Sunday's loss to San Francisco.
 Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert injured the middle finger on his left hand in Sunday's loss to Houston, head coach Jim Harbaugh said. Herbert, who was removed from the game while trailing, 41-15, told reporters he doesn't expect his finger to cause an issue moving forward. Wide receiver Ladd McConkey experienced back spasms during pregame warmups and did not play. Cornerback  Isas Waxter (ankle) was ruled out. Cornerback  Cam Hart  (ankle) and defensive lineman  Justin Eboigbe (ankle) did not return.
 Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua suffered a knee injury on the team's final offensive snap of Sunday's win over Washington and will undergo testing on Monday to determine the injury's severity, NFL Network Insider Mike Garafolo and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported . The Rams do not believe Nacua suffered a torn ACL, per Garafolo and Schefter. Offensive lineman Steve Avila (hamstring) was ruled out.
 Miami Dolphins quarterback Malik Willis told reporters after Sunday's loss to Detroit he was dealing with groin tightness.
 New England Patriots  running back Rhamondre Stevenson (knee), offensive lineman  Ben Brown (knee) and safety Brenden Schooler (hamstring) were ruled out of Sunday's loss to Green Bay. Cornerback Carlton Davis (knee) and offensive tackle Will Campbell (knee) did not return.
 New Orleans Saints center Erik McCoy (bicep) did not return to Sunday's win over Cleveland.
 Philadelphia Eagles linebacker Zack Baun (back) did not return to Sunday's loss to the Giants.
 San Francisco 49ers  defensive lineman Gracen Halton suffered a fractured ankle in Sunday's win over Las Vegas and is out for the season, head coach Kyle Shanahan said. Halton was carted off the field wearing an air cast late in the fourth quarter. Cornerbacks Renardo Green (back) and Deommodore Lenoir (foot) did not return.
 Seattle Seahawks quarterback Drew Lock suffered an oblique injury in Sunday's win over Arizona and his availability is up in the air for Week 10, head coach Mike Macdonald said.
 Tampa Bay Buccaneers  safety Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) was ruled out of Sunday night's loss against the Bears.
 Washington Commanders center Lucas Patrick (concussion) was ruled out of Sunday's loss to the Rams.
